nodes.question: What challenges does the LCA methodology face in business contexts and circular practices?
nodes.answer: The LCA methodology faces challenges such as the difficulty of collecting reliable and accurate data necessary for traceability and transparency, particularly affecting the Life Cycle Inventory phase. This leads to the use of estimates or exclusion of production steps, compromising the accuracy of assessments.
nodes.paragraph: However, the LCA methodology presents relevant chal- lenges that may affect its application in business contexts (Testa et al. 2016; Sassanelli et al. 2019) and in circular practices (Toniolo et al. 2023). These include the difficulty of collecting reliable and accurate data needed to ensure traceability and transparency of the analysis (Saberi et al. 2019; Sassanelli et al. 2019; Carri res et al. 2021). The lack of complete and quality data especially affects the Life Cycle Inventory phase (Notarnicola et al. 2022), which requires systematic collection of all inputs and outputs involved in the different stages of the product life cycle. Hence, the need to use estimates or exclude several steps in the pro- duction process, compromising the accuracy of assessments and increasing the variability and uncertainty of results (Salomone et al. 2010; Guo and Murphy 2012; Henriksen et al. 2019).
